verdict.rationale: Green and Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal services such as visa applications, green cards, and compliance matters. It is not a software product or AI agent that could act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows any software or agent capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
